options.label: search_document: the invoice is overdue
options.content: Embedded as something you're storing for later retrieval. This is the framing you'd use for every chunk you put into your vector table - the model was trained to treat text tagged this way as "content that might get searched for later," and shapes the resulting vector accordingly.

options.label: search_query: the invoice is overdue
options.content: The exact same words, embedded as a question you're about to search WITH. Because the model was trained to treat this prefix differently, the resulting vector isn't identical to the document-tagged version above - and mixing these up (embedding your stored documents with the query prefix, or vice versa) quietly degrades how well queries match the documents they should, without ever throwing an error.
